includeTweetMetadata.description: Attach the post's author, text and publish date to every transcript row.
includeTweetMetadata.title: Include post details

includeWordTimestamps.description: Add per-word start/end times to AI (Whisper) transcript segments. Automatically enabled when Segment granularity is Sentence or Word. Native captions only carry words when X included inline timing markers.
includeWordTimestamps.title: Include word timestamps

language.description: Optional language code for AI transcription, for example en, es, fr or ur. Improves accuracy when the spoken language is known. Leave empty to detect it automatically. Ignored when native captions are used.
language.title: Spoken language hint (AI only)

outputFormat.description: Segments gives timestamped lines, full text gives one transcript string, and both gives you both in the same row.
outputFormat.title: Output format

postUrls.description: One or more Twitter/X post links that contain a video or GIF. Both x.com and twitter.com links are accepted. Profile links or usernames also work: the actor transcribes the profile's latest video post.
postUrls.title: Post links

profileUrls.description: Optional. Transcribe the latest video post from these profiles. Paste x.com profile links or bare usernames.
profileUrls.title: Profile links or usernames

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use an Apify proxy if you plan large runs or see frequent rate limits.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional settings for large or repeated runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

segmentGranularity.description: Level of the timestamped segments. Segment keeps the raw caption/Whisper cues. Sentence groups real word timings into sentences (or splits cue text, sharing the cue's real time range). Word emits one entry per real word timestamp and is used only when X captions or Whisper provide per-word timings — it is never fabricated; when word timings are missing, the row says so and keeps the raw segments.
segmentGranularity.title: Segment granularity

transcriptionMethod.description: Auto tries the video's built-in captions first and only falls back to Whisper AI when none exist. Captions-only skips videos without captions. AI-only always uses Whisper speech-to-text.
enumTitles: Auto — built-in captions first, AI fallback
Built-in captions only — skip videos without captions
AI (Whisper) only — always transcribe the audio
transcriptionMethod.title: How to transcribe

whisperModel.description: Whisper model used for AI transcription. Larger models are more accurate but slower and need more memory (medium and large-v2 need a run memory of at least 4096 MB and 8192 MB respectively). Base is a good balance for most videos. If the selected model does not fit the run memory, the actor automatically falls back to the next smaller model. Long videos are split into 10-minute chunks automatically, so there is no length limit.
whisperModel.title: AI model size
